component.name: linuxBee
component.summary: Organise, tag, convert and play a music library

description.p: linuxBee is a music manager and player for Linux, made for people with a large, carefully tagged library. It edits tags one file or a thousand at a time, renames and moves files from their tags, and converts between formats.
It is an independent project, written from public documentation, and is not affiliated with any other music player.
